title: GL-12 — Step Functions
stopChargesPanel: Delete state machine and IAM role used by Step Functions.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on Step Functions; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Execution role
bullets: Run `aws iam create-role --role-name workbook-gl12-sfn --assume-role-policy-document file://gl12-trust.json --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-12 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`
Run `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name workbook-gl12-sfn --policy-name gl12-log --policy-document file://gl12-log-policy.json`.
Run `$SfnRoleArn = aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-gl12-sfn --query Role.Arn --output text`.
Success: role Arn is set.

steps.title: State machine
bullets: Save gl12.asl.json with Pass state ending Succeed.

Run `$SmArn = aws stepfunctions create-state-machine --name workbook-gl12 --definition file://gl12.asl.json --role-arn $SfnRoleArn --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-12 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt --query stateMachineArn --output text`.
Success: state machine Arn is set.

steps.title: Start execution
bullets: Run `$ExecArn = aws stepfunctions start-execution --state-machine-arn $SmArn --input '{}' --query executionArn --output text`.
Run `aws stepfunctions describe-execution --execution-arn $ExecArn`.
Success: status SUCCEEDED.

steps.title: List executions
bullets: Run `aws stepfunctions list-executions --state-machine-arn $SmArn --max-results 1`.
Success: your execution appears.

steps.title: Transition cost note
bullets: Standard workflows bill per state transition; this run used one Pass.
Success: you noted the estimate from the card.

steps.title: Prepare delete
bullets: Delete state machine, then IAM role policy and role.
Success: Stop charges order is clear.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: state machine, IAM role
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-12` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-12 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-12 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-12. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Minimal Standard workflow with one successful execution.
